title: DST crossing: a Phoenix party (no daylight saving) answers "Tuesday at 10am my time" for Tue Nov 3, after US fall-back on Nov 1. 10am MST is noon Eastern after the change (1pm before it). Record the yes on the noon slot, book.
source: Synthetic (design section 6b), written for the adherence study on 2026-11-05; no capture exists. Calendar generated by scenarios/synthetic/calendar.ts from Bob's weekly pattern (titles, attendees and places in the captured fixtures' anonymized vocabulary), the scheduling policy is plan 39's (Winnie's config at ca6b6ee). The window (Oct 29 to Nov 4) spans the 2026-11-01 transition; the three offers are 10am, 10am and 11am Phoenix time on their days (Fri Oct 30 1pm EDT, Tue Nov 3 noon and 1pm EST).

thread.text:
Hi,

+Winnie (agent) to help us schedule this one. Could you find us 30 minutes over the next week
for an intro call? Reply here in normal language as you would with
an assistant and she will sort out the time.

Bob

Hello,

I'm Winnie, Bob's virtual assistant. Bob asked me to set up 30 minutes with you on a Meet link. Here are times that work on his side:

- Fri, Oct 30, 1:00pm to 1:30pm ET
- Tue, Nov 3, 12:00pm to 12:30pm ET
- Tue, Nov 3, 1:00pm to 1:30pm ET

If one of those suits, say so and I will send the invite. If none do, send me a couple of times that work for you and I will check them.

Winnie
Virtual scheduling assistant to Bob, Example Co

sent.summary: Offered three times on a Meet link, Bob in cc.

events.trigger: Dana Vale replied on the thread.

thread.text:
Hi Winnie, Tuesday at 10am my time works great (I'm in Phoenix).

Dana

expect.basis: The accept rule of the loop prompt (match their words to the offered slot's time) with a zone restated, as central-time (phase 2a): Phoenix is UTC-7 all year; Indianapolis is UTC-4 until Nov 1 and UTC-5 after, so 10am Phoenix on Tue Nov 3 is noon Eastern (slot 502). V4 fires on 503 (1pm, the pre-transition three-hour gap) or on 11am.
expect.notes: Slot 501 (Fri Oct 30 1pm EDT) is also 10am Phoenix, on the wrong day: a yes there is a wrong slot, not V4. The state shows Bob's times with no zone label, only "(America/Indianapolis)" in its header.
